title: Tether Holds 150,000 Bitcoin CEO Says, 50,000 More Than Its Reserve Report Shows
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Tether Holds 150,000 Bitcoin CEO Says, 50,000 More Than Its Reserve Report Shows Tether CEO Paolo Ardoino said in Lugano that the company holds about 150,000 bitcoin worth $11.5 billion. This post Tether Holds 150,000 Bitcoin CEO Says, 50,000 More Than Its Reserve Report Shows first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
